_comment: Hand-maintained facts for the video. Change them here, then run scripts/build_data.py. Sources in brackets.

dataset.name: main-clean4
dataset.labels_checked: main-clean3: 242 / 242 sort labels checked (main-clean4 keeps all of them)
dataset._source: Fallback only: scripts/coverage.py counts the sort model's dataset. main-clean4 = Pi0.5-v2-8gpu (cf96b132…), 81,867 frames, 45.5 min

models._source: The model of tonight's measured arm runs (loop/runs/20261114_222338, _224325; latest:pi05 at the time). Pi0.5-one-8gpu-b (one-clean, imported 23:17) is newer and NOT measured yet: pin --model Pi0.5-v2-8gpu for the take, or re-measure

sentences.GOOD: The brick is good. Put it on the green plate.
sentences.DEFECTIVE: The brick is defective. Put it on the orange plate.

evaluation._source: Filled automatically from video/layouts/round_*_eval.json (tools/eval_round.py). Set numbers here only to override them by hand.

run_take._source: the filmed round: its loop/runs folder, its layout file (video/layouts/round_NN.json), and the footage time where the log's first cycle starts. plate_swap_shown: set false if the mid-run plate swap failed in testing; the run scene then drops that part (VIDEO_PLAN 13.5)

policy.training: 8 H100s on Modal, 4 epochs, 5,116 steps, no validation split, image augmentation off
policy.chunk_ms_source: median of per-stage inference_ms over 97 pick and sort stages on the arm, same runs

inspection.crop: 360 px square around the brick, found by colour at the red finger tips
inspection.held_out: 28 photos at the two stops (14 clean, 14 defective): scores don't overlap (lowest defective 0.588, highest good 0.491)
inspection.ms_cpu_npu_note: short run while the loop was running: re-measure on a quiet laptop
inspection.int8: 31 → 7.9 MB, scores within 0.05 of FP32 (mean 0.016) on the 28 photos
inspection.full_int8: moved scores by up to 0.28: not used
inspection.train_time: 5 min on the Intel GPU (641 photos, 2% coreset)
inspection.first_live_failure: first live run rejected a clean brick at 1.0: the heatmap was on the wrist-camera bracket and a loose brick, not the brick (loop/runs/20261114_201611)
inspection._source: JUNCTION_SUBMISSION_TEXT_V2.md 'Where each number comes from'; anomaly/README.md

failures: PICK.MISS: 14 of 55 pick attempts timed out; the top camera moved about 20 px after recording and pi0.5 was trained without image augmentation
INSP.FALSE: 3 clean bricks rejected: a long curved brick held by its end (twice) and a tall brick, views the good photos barely contain
INSP.MARGIN: dark marker on a blue brick scored 0.55 to 0.68, close to the limit; the second look decided
INSP.FACES: only the two ungripped faces are checked
GRIP.SENSE: the soft gripper reads the same holding a brick or not; an empty grasp is only caught at inspection
results._source: JUNCTION_SUBMISSION_TEXT_V2.md; recounted 23:30 (picks 41 done / 14 timeout / 6 stopped up to cycle 85). Recount at the end: the run is still going
